mapper.insert: insert into forum_posts (title, content, views, likes, status, created_at, image_url , user_id) values (#{forumPosts.title}, #{forumPosts.content}, #{forumPosts.views}, #{forumPosts.likes}, #{forumPosts.status}, NOW(), #{imageUrlJson} , #{forumPosts.userId})
insert into forum_comments (post_id, user_id, content, likes, status, created_at) VALUES (#{postId}, #{userId}, #{content}, #{likes}, #{status}, NOW())
mapper.select: select *, (select username from users where forum_posts.user_id = users.id) as username, (select count(*) from forum_comments where forum_comments.post_id = forum_posts.id) as commentsCount from forum_posts ORDER BY created_at DESC
select fc.*, (select username from users where id = fc.user_id) as username from forum_comments fc where post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY fc.created_at DESC
